positions.description: Promoted to Staff Software Engineer.

positions.description:
Consolo was acquired by WellSky as part of its expansion plans.

Continuing developement of our flagship ADS software on the HCL Notes/Domino platform.

positions.title: Domino Developer/Administrator
positions.description: ADSDS was wholly acquired by Consolo Services Group as part of their expansion into the Adult Day Services industry.

positions.title: IT Manager
positions.description:
Manage all aspects of corporate IT, from budgeting and technical direction through implementation, support and maintenance. Ongoing responsibilities include onsite and remote support of 100 users; procure and setup all desktop, server, and network hardware and software; plan and implement hardware and software upgrades and migrations; and manage network security.

Administer 4 Lotus Domino 8.5-based servers (Windows Server 2003/2008) comprising mail, Notes- and web-based applications, Sametime and Quickr, and support mobile users via Lotus Traveler. Maintained, planned and upgraded Domino infrastructure from version 5 through present. Fully versed in all aspects of Domino administration including server planning/sizing, user policy management, migration, troubleshooting, and user ID maintenance. Designed and developed wide range of Domino-based applications for all departments. Developed inaugural corporate e-commerce website (Domino-based) and customer-specific e-commerce websites customized with their individual catalogs. Thorough experiencewith Domino and web-based development including @ formulas, LotusScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, and beginning XPages projects. Deep experience with onsite and remote end user support via direct contact, training classes, demonstrations, video “how-to's”, and written documentation.

positions.title: Network Manager
positions.description: Responsible for overall PC equipment, servers, and network infrastructure, including Internet access and connectivity to secondary facility. Architected, installed, and administered Lotus Domino 5.x environment for corporate email and provide Notes database development for both internal and intranet/extranet-based applications.

positions.title: Lotus Notes Supervisor
positions.description: Administered 10 Lotus Domino 4.x servers throughout the company and oversaw all internal and external Notes application development. Planned and executed migration to Notes/Domino 5.0. Experience in Notes development includes workflow and document resource databases, email, and calendaring and scheduling (C&S). Familiar with intranet/extranet development using Notes/Domino environment, and with internet email protocols including SMTP and POP as integrated with Domino email services.

positions.title: Group Systems Analyst
positions.description: Provided on-site and remote hardware and software technical support for a major company division comprising approximately 20 of 60 branch sites located throughout the United States. Assisted in administering Novell NetWare 4.10 at these branches. Designed and developed Lotus Notes applications for various groups within the division. Member of team that developed corporate standards and processes for Notes application development.

positions.title: Manager, Product Development
positions.description: Responsible for overall product development, maintenance, telephone and on-site customer support.  Worked extensively with end-user laboratory management and staff to customize and refine flagship program.  Provided technical support for customers to the Product Management and Marketing and Sales divisions.  Advised technical writers in documenting program operation and wrote sections of the end-user manual.
